title: feat(ui,spec): userActions.exportCsv false hides the console Export entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoM2Z7gQnCvEUfEceUuUKyBZ)_
Fixes #35619

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — skills/** never teaches the object-level `userActions` block (its only `userActions` hits are the VIEW-level block in objectstack-ui's list-views and navigation rules); the author-facing docs are updated here (content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx, content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-list.mdx)

## 维护者速读

- 搭建者在对象表单里关掉「导出」开关后,该对象的表格、列表页和报表都不再显示下载数据的「导出」按钮;以前关了也照样显示,没设置的对象不变;甘特图把图表导出成图片或文档的按钮不受这个开关影响。
- 替在设计器里关掉导出开关的搭建者兑现这个设置:开关一直能设,却从没生效(维护者已裁定「生效」而不是「删除」)。
- 出错最多是某个对象的导出按钮该显示却不显示,或反之;它只隐藏入口、不拦服务端导出,整改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Ruling: **Enforce** (comment 7035537883 on the card). An object's `userActions.exportCsv: false` now hides the console's data Export entry for that object: the CSV, XLSX or JSON download on the grid (toolbar menu, table CSV button), the list view (wide toolbar, Display panel) and the dataset report. A view's export of the picture it draws is not covered: the Gantt view's PNG and PDF buttons stay (Acceptance notes). Every surface reads one verdict, `isObjectExportOffered(objectSchema, effectiveApiOperations)`, new in `@object-ui/core`. That verdict is the authored bit over the object's `managedBy` default, ANDed with the caller's effective `export` operation. Before this change the grid's toolbar menu, the list view and the report read the effective operation but not the object's bit, and the grid's table CSV button read neither half (only `operations.export`), so `exportCsv: false` changed nothing.

- **The verdict** (`@object-ui/core`): `isObjectExportOffered` in `managedBy.ts`, beside `isObjectInlineEditable`, returns the resolved `exportCsv` bit from `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances`. No surface calls `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` itself, because the affordance-to-grant census (`affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`) refuses that call outside its home modules. Why a helper and not an `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS` row is under Acceptance notes.
- **ObjectGrid** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`): one name, `objectExportOffered`, gates three things: the toolbar Export menu (`exportEnabled`), `handleExport`, and the table's own CSV button that `operations.export: true` turns on (`exportable`).
- **ListView** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`): `exportPermitted` folds in the verdict. Both toolbar forms already read that name: the wide toolbar's Export button and the Display panel's export footer. `handleExport` reads it too.
- **Dataset report** (`@object-ui/plugin-report`): `ReportExportControl` reads the base object's definition (the query answer's `object`) through the report's data source with `useSettledSchema`, then applies the same verdict. `DatasetReportRenderer` passes its `dataSource` down.
- **RelatedList**: no change. It draws no export entry at all, so there is nothing to gate. Evidence is in Acceptance notes.
- **Spec** (`@objectstack/spec`):
  - the `exportCsv` describe and the Studio object form's help text now say what the key does, narrowed in round 2 to the data Export entry it gates;
  - round 2 also fixes three older sentences: `CrudAffordances.exportCsv`'s docblock no longer says "CSV / clipboard export"; the `userActions` docblock's example no longer has an append-only table "expose CSV Export", which it does by default; and the `read` / `view` guidance no longer says `userActions` toggles write affordances only. The form row's label stays "Export CSV", since changing it would ripple into ten locale bundles;
  - the liveness ledger row `object.userActions.exportCsv` moves `dead` → `live`, citing the readers by `file#symbol`;
  - the generated reference row and the state-count shard are regenerated.
- **Docs**: the `userActions` row in content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx; a new "The object's Export switch" section in content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-list.mdx; an Export section in each of the three plugin READMEs.
- **Translations** (`@objectstack/platform-objects`): the English metadata-forms bundle is regenerated for the new help text. The ten translated locales keep their wording (merge mode).
- Changeset: `.changeset/35619-user-actions-export-csv-enforced.md`. It grades spec, `@object-ui/core` and the three ui plugins `minor` and platform-objects `patch`, and carries the `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol:` lines.
- **Docs**, round 1: the core README gains a section on `isObjectExportOffered`; the three plugin READMEs, plugin-list.mdx and the ledger evidence now name the helper.

Unchanged, per the rulings: the ADR-0103 bucket defaults (`exportCsv: true` in every bucket) and ADR-0153. No server gate is added; the REST export route is out of scope. The setting hides an entry and is not a permission: who may export is still the permission set's `allowExport`.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/core/src/utils/managedBy.ts`: `isObjectExportOffered`, the one export verdict and the new public name (Clause-② yes). Its docblock says why it asks no `can(object, verb)`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/ReportExport.tsx`: the new definition read through the data source. A source that cannot serve `getObjectSchema` keeps the control, and so does a definition still in flight (fail-open).
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: the `exportable: operations?.export && objectExportOffered` hunk. The table's own CSV button now also follows the effective `export` operation, which it did not read before.

### Two-minute check

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/exportCsvGate-35619.test.tsx`. Expect `Tests  4 passed (4)`: `exportCsv: false` finds neither the toolbar Export menu nor the table's CSV button, and the three controls find both.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/exportCsvGate-35619.test.tsx` (4):
  - `exportCsv: false` hides both the toolbar Export menu and the table CSV button;
  - CONTROL: unset keeps both;
  - CONTROL: `true` keeps both;
  - closing `edit`/`delete` leaves export open.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe('ListView.exportCsvGate-35619')` (5):
  - wide toolbar: `false` hides Export; CONTROLS for unset and `true`;
  - Display panel footer: `false` hides every format entry; CONTROL.
- `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportExport.exportCsvGate-35619.test.tsx` (3): `false` hides the report's Export control; CONTROLS for unset and `true`.
- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/managedBy.test.ts`, new top-level `describe('isObjectExportOffered — the one export verdict (objectstack#35619)')` (5). It covers:
  - unset, in every bucket;
  - `false` and `true`, in every bucket;
  - other verbs closed;
  - the effective set;
  - agreement with `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances(...).exportCsv` over every bucket, authored value and effective set.

Readings, fix round 2, at eabd7836. The change is prose only. The L2 record (7064709267) raised S1: the sentences claimed every Export entry and every format, but the Gantt view's PNG / PDF buttons are outside the gate. Round 2 narrows the describe, the help text, the `isObjectExportOffered` docblock, the liveness note, the core and plugin-list READMEs, objects.mdx, plugin-list.mdx and the changeset to the data Export entry, and says the Gantt picture export is not covered. ## Acceptance notes

- **RelatedList has no export entry.** The ruling names RelatedList as an export surface. At `origin/main`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` draws no Export button, menu or handler, and sets `exportable: false` on its table, so there is nothing to gate. The diff does not touch it, and the ledger note records this.
- **Fail-open while the definition loads.** All three surfaces resolve with the bucket default until the object definition lands. Sibling affordances behave the same way. Every bucket defaults `exportCsv` to `true`, so the entry can show for a moment on an object that authors `false`. The pins wait for the definition before they look.
- **Table CSV button now follows the effective `export` operation.** Before, the data-table's own CSV button (`operations.export: true`) read nothing but that flag. It now reads `objectExportOffered`, which includes the server's effective operation set. This matches the toolbar menu it sits beside.
- **Legacy `ReportViewer` untouched.** It gates on the report's own `allowExport` and is not bound to an object.
- **Interim changeset text.** The unreleased `.changeset/35401-user-actions-transfer.md` paragraph says `exportCsv` is dead and warns. If both changesets ship in one release, that paragraph describes an interim state, and the seat may amend it as a DELIBERATE CORRECTION. This PR does not edit another PR's changeset.
- **Translated help text kept.** The ten translated `userActions.exportCsv` help texts still say "the CSV export entry, shown when unset". That is still true, but they do not yet mention every format or that the setting is not a permission. Merge mode keeps them, and they are legacy-trusted, so no gate reads them as stale. Refreshing them is translation work and is not done here.
- **Why a helper, not an `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS` row.** Both were measured, and the census-prescribed row does not fit export:
  - the map's rows name a caller grant asked through `can(object, grant)`, typed `create | update | delete`;
  - `@object-ui/permissions` answers `can(object, 'export')` with `allowRead` (`MePermissionsProvider`'s verb map), not `allowExport`, so a row's grant half would ask the wrong bit;
  - the caller's `allowExport` already reaches the client through the effective `export` operation. The server derives it from `list` and that grant (`annotateEffectiveApiOperations` in `@objectstack/core`), and its export door answers `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` without it (`enforceExportPermission` in `@objectstack/rest`);
  - the pin holds every row with a CRUD bit closed under an `append-only` bucket, while ADR-0103 keeps `exportCsv` on in every bucket.

  So the verdict stays exactly as it was, the authored bit ∧ the effective `export` operation, and it lives in the HOME module as a named helper. `OUT_OF_FAMILY` is unchanged.
- **Not covered: a view's picture export (S1).** The Gantt view (`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx`, drawn by ListView for `viewType: gantt`) has two buttons, "Export as PNG" and "Export PDF". They export the chart it draws and read no export verdict. The switch does not hide them, and every sentence this PR writes now says so. Gating them is outside this claim's file surface; it is a separate card if the maintainer wants the chart picture covered.
- **N1, follow-up candidate: the report control paints before its definition read settles.** `ReportExportControl` starts the base object's definition read once the table snapshot exists and reads only `def`. So on a report over an `exportCsv: false` object the control is drawn at least once per open, and for the length of the request when the definition is not cached. Holding it until `useSettledSchema`'s `ready` would remove the flash and keep it open where the source cannot serve a definition. Accepted on this head, since the setting is not a permission.
- **N4, follow-up candidate: the Studio switch reads off for an unset key whose default is on.** The form row renders `checked` from the stored value, so an object that never authored `exportCsv` shows the switch off while export is offered. Writing `false` takes switching on and then off. This predates this PR: the row's comment and the composite's help text already describe it. It is now the row's only useful write, so the form face deserves its own card.
- **Pin placement.** The claim asked for new pin files named for 35619 beside each surface. The ListView pin sits in the shared `ListView.harness.test.tsx` as a top-level describe instead, per the AGENTS.md shared-harness ruling (6583487846).
- **Overlap.** `overlap-check` at eabd7836 reports textual conflicts with two PRs. With #35923 they are only on two generated artifacts, `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` and `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/object.md`; both PRs regenerate them, so whichever lands second merges main and regenerates them. With #36129 (a draft, the related-tab list) the conflict is in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`. That queues the second of the two to land. `origin/main` (dc10b3b4) merges cleanly.
